method: Actual local view_image inspection of all12 plots; two revised images reopened after saved-result-only layout correction.

files.finding: Axes, population counts, voltage/shape units and quantile bands readable; median curves are not full distributions.
Fixed-hash pre-first-peak examples and physical units readable; consistent model onset preserved as a negative observation.
Prompt and postpeak panels readable; prompt includes peak/early fall and is not pure rising edge.
Log charge ticks, component order and qualification gaps readable; not particle truth.
All QC populations and narrow generated bands visible; visual clipping does not alter full-denominator metrics.
Lag, non-DC spectrum, baseline RMS units and legends readable.
Dedicated colorbar column; no counts or output-charge column covered.
All frozen views, controls, conditional uncertainty bars and chance line readable.
Three-view same-parent SD quantiles readable; views are not independent events.
Median changes and 5-95% spread readable; spread is not a confidence interval.
Revised log axes reveal normal trace and the step1900 anomaly together; selection stars/annotation readable.
Revised baseline RMS in mV with sparse ticks; full-denominator histograms and narrow rise band readable.

first_pass_native_view_tool_ids: not retained in this compact QA record; inspection performed before context compaction
